snippet.title: You, Error. | Indie Game Concept Trailer
snippet.description:
Hi! I'm the solo developer behind the game "You,Error." (｡･ω･｡)ﾉ
It's currently participating in the 🌊 RT2 Trailer Challenge! 
Your vote will decide who gets the funding to turn their trailer concept into a bigger game!

===========================
🗳️ VOTE NOW! 🗳️ 
===========================
Watch the amazing indie game trailers and vote for your favorites!
Vote here➡️: https://blueoceangames.com?ref=123
⏰ Round 1 voting ends at 12 PM PST on October 6th

===========================
🌊 Raising Tide Challenge 2 🌊
===========================
A trailer-based voting contest hosted by indie game investment group BOG (@BlueOceanGames).
There are tons of creative indie game trailers to explore!
Come check them out and cast your vote! ^o^

===========================
🎮 You, Error. 🎮
===========================
Game Title: You, Error.
Originally created as an entry for Patch Notes v1.0, a game jam hosted by Indieformer (@indieformer), with a 3-day development window and the theme: "The Error Is The Feature."
The jam just wrapped up! 
Check out the game page for more details➡️: https://emankcin01.itch.io/you-error

===========================
About Me
===========================
➡︎Itch: https://emankcin01.itch.io
➡︎Website: https://emankcin.com

===========================
